description.narrative: Meeting the objectives of the 2022 Humanitarian Response Plan for Somalia.

This allocation contributes to meeting the objectives of the 2022 Humanitarian Response Plan for Somalia focusing on ensuring humanitarian aid to the severely vulnerable part of the population affected by the drought.
The Somalia Humanitarian Fund (SHF) is hosted by OCHA and technically administered by UNDP. Both UNDP and OCHA are trusted and longstanding partners of Denmark. The Fund will follow the UN model for country-based pooled funds, which is considered an important strategic and flexible humanitarian financing tool, including support of localized humanitarian action.
Due to its nature as a response to a humanitarian appeal operational results are general and highly aggregated and the MFA contribution is thus reflected in the overall results reporting by the partner. Please refer to the hyperlink below.
https://www.undp.org/results
